body: How is it possible for this code to be reached?

This changes the semantics of `WorkerThreadPool` while this is correct for ResourceLoader, I don't think that this is always correct for all (potential) callers. WorkerThreadPool is bound to scripting and available to GDExtension. 

For instance the pattern that we are changing in ResourceLoader could be a deliberate choice of some extension author. With this change that behavior is impossible to achieve.

Whether these are desirable semantics is a different matter of course :) But I think that that requires more than a passing note in a bug fix.

The current code in `ResourceLoader::_load_complete_inner()` expects `ResourceLoader::_run_load_task()`  to  be synchronous and for `ThreadLoadTask::resource` to be valid.

This opens a new data race, where it is possible for the retried `_run_load_task()` to return to `_load_complete_inner()` before `_load()` has returned. 

At that point this load will return a (partially) constructed resource at the end of `_load_complete_inner()`. 

This is a new race!
